ns2:section.sectionText: Seats may be reserved by class level or major. This course meets online using Elluminate. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://www.hcd.illinois.edu/student_information/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Agric Leadership & Sci Educ major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
